versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Short Drama/Anime/AI Drama Market Analysis skill.

- Provides analysis of short drama, anime, and AI-driven drama markets.
- Tracks trending works, platform policies, and major market dynamics.
- Offers decision-making support for drama selection using a detailed scoring framework.
- Covers key analysis dimensions: market size, growth, popular genres, platform landscape, production benchmarks, compliance, monetization, competition, and risks.
- Outputs structured market analysis reports based on up-to-date reference data.
